Rules Regulations Notifications Orders Circulars Ordinance Statutes SectionsScheduleAnnexureAppendixFormsActdetails Act ID: 200634 Act Number: 34 Enactment Date: 2006-08-23 Act Year: 2006 Short Title: The Food Safety and Standards Act, 2006 Long Title: An Act to consolidate the laws relating to food and to establish the Food Safety and Standards Authority of India for laying down science based standards for articles of food and to regulate their manufacture, storage, distribution, sale and import, to ensure availability of safe and wholesome food for human consumption and for matters connected therewith or incidental thereto. Department: Department of HEALTH AND FAMILY WELFARE Enforcement Date: 28-05-2008 Type: CENTRAL ACT (Ministry of Health and Family Welfare, Department of Health and Family Welfare) Location: Chhattisgarh Notification: 28th May, 2008 (ss. 3 and 30), vide notification No. S.O. 1246(E), dated 28th May, 2008, see Gazette of India, Extraordinary, Part II,
